chunks: This surely is a reminder: Therefore whosoever desires may take the way to his Lord.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'whosoever desires may take the way to his Lord'?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the balance between divine guidance and human agency, affirming that the Quran serves as a clear reminder (dhikr) while leaving the choice of path to individual volition. It reflects the principle that salvation is not forced but earned through conscious submission, a concept central to the Shia understanding of justice and accountability.
